serviceDetails.title: What jobs do you take on?
paras: We fit a wide range of heating, plumbing and appliance items around the home, including:
list: Radiators, radiator valves and towel rails
Stop taps, isolation valves and outside taps
parasAfter: Not sure if we do it? Ask us. If we cannot help, we will tell you straight away.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer fitting a new kitchen tap in Watford

serviceDetails.title: Do you fit gas appliances?
paras: Yes. By law, gas cookers, hobs and other gas appliances must be fitted by a Gas Safe registered engineer. We connect the appliance, test every joint for leaks, check the flame and make sure there is enough ventilation. You can use it the same day.
See our gas cooker installation page for more detail.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas Safe engineer connecting a gas hob in Watford

serviceDetails.title: Do you plumb in washing machines and dishwashers?
paras: Yes. We connect the water supply and waste, fit new valves where needed, level the machine, test for leaks and run a cycle before we leave. Most fits take under an hour, and we can take your old machine away.
See our washing machine and dishwasher pages for more detail.
serviceDetails.alt: Washing machine plumbed in by an engineer

serviceDetails.title: Can you replace a radiator or towel rail?
paras: Yes. We drain the system, remove the old radiator, fit the new one and new valves, then refill, bleed and test. We can fit a heated towel rail in a bathroom, swap a radiator for a larger one in a cold room, or move a radiator to suit a new layout.
serviceDetails.alt: Radiator replaced in a Watford home

serviceDetails.title: Are your prices clear?
paras: Yes. Tell us what you need, and we give you a fixed price before any work starts. No hidden costs, no surprises. Quotes are free.
We turn up on time, do the job properly, and leave your home clean. If we spot anything else worth fixing while we are there, we tell you, and you decide.
serviceDetails.alt: Fixed price quote for a small plumbing job

serviceDetails.title: Can you do several small jobs in one visit?
paras: Yes, and it often saves you money. Make a list of the jobs around your home, such as a dripping tap, a sticking valve and a new appliance to connect, and we can quote for them all and do them in one visit.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer doing several small jobs in one visit

serviceDetails.title: Why choose AR Heating?
paras: We are a local Watford company, trading since 2007, and every gas job is done under our Gas Safe registration, No. 574111. We give you a fixed price before we start, turn up when we say we will, and leave your home as clean as we found it. If something is not worth doing, we tell you.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas Safe registered AR Heating engineer

serviceDetails.title: Can you fit an outside tap?
paras: Yes. An outside tap makes watering the garden and washing the car far easier. We fit the tap with a check valve to protect your drinking water, and an isolation valve inside so you can turn it off in winter to stop it freezing.
serviceDetails.alt: Outside tap fitted on a Watford home

serviceDetails.title: Why fit isolation valves?
paras: An isolation valve lets you turn off the water to one tap, toilet or appliance without shutting off the whole house. If something leaks, you can stop it fast. We fit them under sinks, behind toilets and on appliance supplies, often as part of another job.
serviceDetails.alt: Isolation valve fitted under a sink

serviceDetails.title: Where do you cover?
paras: We are based at Unit 24, The Roundway, Watford, WD18 6LB, and fit appliances and fittings across Watford, Bushey, Rickmansworth, Hemel Hempstead, St Albans, Harrow, Pinner, Stanmore, Edgware, Ruislip and Northolt. We are Gas Safe registered (No. 574111), fully insured, and you can check our number on the Gas Safe Register before we arrive.
serviceDetails.alt: AR Heating engineer at a home in Watford
